Connecting WhatsApp with Facebook

Connecting your WhatsApp number with Facebook

At the end of this guide, your WhatsApp number is connected to AI Sales Closer, and the assistant replies to messages on it.

You do every step in one sitting. The Facebook window opens from AI Sales Closer, and closes itself at the end. Do not close it early.

Before you start

You need:

  • A Facebook account you can log in to.
  • A phone number that can receive a text message, and that is not in use on the WhatsApp app or the WhatsApp Business app.
  • Your AI Sales Closer workspace, with access to Settings.
  • A browser that allows pop-up windows from the AI Sales Closer site.
  • About 10 minutes, and the phone that receives the number’s text messages.

Step by step

01

Open the WhatsApp channel in AI Sales Closer

  1. In AI Sales Closer, go to Settings → Channels.
  2. Open the WhatsApp section.
  3. Check that Transport reads Meta direct (default).

The Connect WhatsApp box shows a green Connect with Facebook button.

02

Open the Facebook window

  1. Press Connect with Facebook. A Facebook window opens.
  2. Log in to Facebook in that window.

No window means your browser blocked it. Allow pop-ups for the AI Sales Closer site, and press the button again.

03

Accept the introduction

The window reads Seamlessly connect your account to 41 Labs.

  1. Read the terms linked at the bottom of the screen.
  2. Press Continue.
04

Add your WhatsApp phone number

The window reads Add your WhatsApp phone number.

  1. In the Phone number list, keep Create a new one.
  2. Select your country code in the list on the left.
  3. Type the number, without the country code, in the field on the right.
  4. Press Next. Meta sends a code by text message to that number.
05

Verify the number with the code

The window reads Verify your phone number.

  1. Type the 6-digit code from the text message into the Verification code boxes.
  2. Press Next.

No code? When the timer ends, request a new code, or change the verification method.

06

Choose or create your business portfolio

The window reads Select the business assets to share with Hermes AI sales agent. Follow one path:

No business portfolio yetPath A. You create a portfolio and a WhatsApp Business account.
A business portfolio alreadyPath B. You pick your portfolio, and create a WhatsApp Business account in it.

Path A — create a new business portfolio

  1. In the Business portfolio list, select Create a business portfolio.
  2. In the WhatsApp Business account list, select Create a WhatsApp Business account.
  3. Press Next.

The window reads Enter business information for new assets.

  1. Type your business Name, Email and Website.
  2. Select your Category, Country and Time zone.
  3. Press Next.

Path B — use your existing business portfolio

  1. In the Business portfolio list, select your portfolio.
  2. In the WhatsApp Business account list, select Create a WhatsApp Business account.
  3. Press Next.
07

Review the access and confirm

The window reads Review what you’ll share with Hermes AI sales agent. It lists Business and WhatsApp Business account, and what AI Sales Closer can do with them.

Press Confirm.

08

Wait while Meta connects the account

The window reads Connecting your account. This takes a few moments. Keep the window open.

If the screen stops moving, press Retry.

09

Finish in the Facebook window

The window reads Your account is connected to 41 Labs. Under Assets successfully created, it lists your WhatsApp account.

  1. Under Improve your experience, tick or clear each option.
  2. To add a card for WhatsApp charges now, press Add payment method. You can also add it later in Meta.
  3. Press Finish. The window closes, and you return to AI Sales Closer.

Meta reviews your business, and gets in touch within 24 hours if there is an issue.

10

Save your two-step PIN

The Connect WhatsApp box reads Connected!, with three green ticks:

  • Connected to your WhatsApp account
  • App subscribed to your WABA
  • Number registered with WhatsApp

Below them, the green box shows your Two-step PIN. Copy it into your password manager now.

AI Sales Closer shows the PIN once. AI Sales Closer does not store it, and the box does not show it again. WhatsApp asks for it to move the number later.

11

Confirm the assistant replies

  1. From another phone, send a WhatsApp message to your connected number.
  2. Check that the assistant replies on WhatsApp.
  3. Check that the conversation shows in AI Sales Closer.

If something goes wrong

What you seeWhat to do
No window opens after Connect with FacebookAllow pop-ups for the AI Sales Closer site, and press the button again.
No code arrivesWait for the timer on the Verify your phone number screen. Then request a new code, or change the verification method.
Meta does not accept the numberDelete the number’s account in the WhatsApp app or the WhatsApp Business app, or use another number. Then start again from Step 2.
Connecting your account does not finishPress Retry.
You closed the window before FinishAI Sales Closer still shows Connect with Facebook. Press it, and start again from Step 2.
You lost the two-step PINIn WhatsApp Manager, open the number’s settings, and change the two-step verification PIN.
The assistant does not replyCheck the three green ticks in Step 10. Then reply to your 41 Labs contact.

Checklist

Good to know

  • To paste your WhatsApp credentials by hand instead, press Enter manually below the button, and follow the guide Connecting your WhatsApp number.
  • Meta bills WhatsApp charges to the payment method on your WhatsApp Business account.
  • Send your two-step PIN to nobody.
Questions? Reply to your 41 Labs contact.
